# Inicio

**Elige una de las pestañas disponibles para realizar el análisis**:


  -   **_Longitudinal_**: En este apartado se comparan los promedios de las dimensiones y subdimensiones a través de un gráfico de líneas histórico. Para proyectar los análisis, debes seleccionar un elemento a visualizar.
  
  -   **_Ranking_**: Sigue la misma lógica que la sección mapa, pero mostrando un ranking ordenado por dimensiones y subdimensiones, para cada ola disponible. 

  -   **_Bivariado_**: Aquí se encuentran dos selectores entre los que encontrarás las dimensiones y subdimensiones, además de algunas variables de caracterización sociodemográficas.  

Todas los indicadores, subdimensiones y dimensiones fueron construidos a partir de índices promediados.
  
Más información sobre las fuentes de datos, la selección de indicadores y la construcción de los índices <a href="https://ocscoes.github.io/propuesta-medicion-elsoc/output/book-cohesion-elsoc/docs/index.html" target="_blank">aquí</a>.

```{r}
#| context: server

# ---- Base bivariados ----

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Helper: draw Likert 1–5 with integer noise (±1)
draw_likert_noise <- function(n, probs = NULL, p_shift = c(0.1, 0.6, 0.8)) {
  base  <- sample(1:5, n, replace = TRUE, prob = probs)                 # base Likert
  noise <- sample(c(-1, 0, 1), n, replace = TRUE, prob = p_shift)       # jitter
  pmin(pmax(base + noise, 1), 5)                                        # clamp to 1–5
}

# Number of respondents
n <- 1000

# Create simulated dataset
dfsim16 <- data.frame(
  id = 1:n,
  wave = 2016,
  
  # Indicators (Likert 1-5 with integer noise)
  public_meetings = draw_likert_noise(n),
  volunteering    = draw_likert_noise(n),
  lend_money      = draw_likert_noise(n),
  help_job        = draw_likert_noise(n),
  social_trust    = draw_likert_noise(n),
  social_altruism = draw_likert_noise(n),
  firma_peticion  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  asiste_marcha   = draw_likert_noise(n),
  part_huelga     = draw_likert_noise(n),
  voto_deber  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  voto_influye  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  voto_expresion  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  interes_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  habla_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  informa_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n)
)

dfsim16 <- dfsim16 %>%
  mutate(
    prosocial_behavior     = rowMeans(select(., public_meetings, volunteering), na.rm = TRUE),
    economic_help          = rowMeans(select(., lend_money, help_job), na.rm = TRUE),
    interpersonal_trust    = rowMeans(select(., social_trust, social_altruism), na.rm = TRUE),
    part_pol    = rowMeans(select(., firma_peticion, asiste_marcha, part_huelga), na.rm = TRUE),
    autoeff_pol    = rowMeans(select(., voto_deber, voto_influye, voto_expresion), na.rm = TRUE),
    interes_pol    = rowMeans(select(., interes_politica, habla_politica, informa_politica), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Create simulated dataset

  interes_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  habla_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  informa_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n)
)

dfsim17 <- dfsim17 %>%
  mutate(
    prosocial_behavior     = rowMeans(select(., public_meetings, volunteering), na.rm = TRUE),
    economic_help          = rowMeans(select(., lend_money, help_job), na.rm = TRUE),
    interpersonal_trust    = rowMeans(select(., social_trust, social_altruism), na.rm = TRUE),
    part_pol    = rowMeans(select(., firma_peticion, asiste_marcha, part_huelga), na.rm = TRUE),

# Create simulated dataset

dfsim18 <- dfsim18 %>%
  mutate(
    prosocial_behavior     = rowMeans(select(., public_meetings, volunteering), na.rm = TRUE),
    economic_help          = rowMeans(select(., lend_money, help_job), na.rm = TRUE),

dfsim19 <- data.frame(
  id = 1:n,
  wave = 2019,
  
  # Indicators (Likert 1-5 with integer noise)
  public_meetings = draw_likert_noise(n),
  volunteering    = draw_likert_noise(n),
  lend_money      = draw_likert_noise(n),

  social_trust    = draw_likert_noise(n),

dfsim19 <- dfsim19 %>%
  mutate(
    prosocial_behavior     = rowMeans(select(., public_meetings, volunteering), na.rm = TRUE),
    economic_help          = rowMeans(select(., lend_money, help_job), na.rm = TRUE),
    interpersonal_trust    = rowMeans(select(., social_trust, social_altruism), na.rm = TRUE),
    part_pol    = rowMeans(select(., firma_peticion, asiste_marcha, part_huelga), na.rm = TRUE),

# Create simulated dataset
dfsim22 <- data.frame(
  id = 1:n,
  wave = 2022,
  
   # Indicators (Likert 1-5 with integer noise)
  public_meetings = draw_likert_noise(n),
  volunteering    = draw_likert_noise(n),
  lend_money      = draw_likert_noise(n),
  help_job        = draw_likert_noise(n),
  social_trust    = draw_likert_noise(n),
  social_altruism = draw_likert_noise(n),
  firma_peticion  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  asiste_marcha   = draw_likert_noise(n),
  part_huelga     = draw_likert_noise(n),
  voto_deber  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  voto_influye  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  voto_expresion  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  interes_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  habla_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n),
  informa_politica  = draw_likert_noise(n)
)

dfsim22 <- dfsim22 %>%
  mutate(
    prosocial_behavior     = rowMeans(select(., public_meetings, volunteering), na.rm = TRUE),
    economic_help          = rowMeans(select(., lend_money, help_job), na.rm = TRUE),
    interpersonal_trust    = rowMeans(select(., social_trust, social_altruism), na.rm = TRUE),
    part_pol    = rowMeans(select(., firma_peticion, asiste_marcha, part_huelga), na.rm = TRUE),

    interes_pol    = rowMeans(select(., interes_politica, habla_politica, informa_politica), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

dfsim <- bind_rows(dfsim16,dfsim17,dfsim18,dfsim19, dfsim22) %>% arrange(id)

# Asignar género de forma aleatoria (0 = Hombre, 1 = Mujer)
# Cada ID tiene el mismo género en todas las olas
set.seed(456)
gender_assignment <- data.frame(
  id = 1:n,
  genero = sample(c(0, 1), n, replace = TRUE)
)

dfsim <- dfsim %>%
  left_join(gender_assignment, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(genero = factor(genero, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Hombre", "Mujer")))

dfgrouped <- 
dfsim %>% group_by(wave, genero) %>% 
  summarise(  # Indicators (Likert 1-5 with integer noise)
    public_meetings = mean(public_meetings),
    volunteering    = mean(volunteering   ),
    lend_money      = mean(lend_money     ),
    help_job        = mean(help_job       ),
    social_trust    = mean(social_trust   ),
    social_altruism = mean(social_altruism),
    firma_peticion = mean(firma_peticion),
    asiste_marcha = mean(asiste_marcha),
    part_huelga = mean(part_huelga),
    voto_deber = mean(voto_deber),
    voto_influye = mean(voto_influye),
    voto_expresion = mean(voto_expresion),
    interes_politica = mean(interes_politica),
    habla_politica = mean(habla_politica),
    informa_politica = mean(informa_politica),
    .groups = 'drop'
    )

df_long <- dfgrouped %>%
  select(wave, genero, social_trust, social_altruism, firma_peticion, asiste_marcha, part_huelga,
         voto_deber, voto_influye, voto_expresion, interes_politica, habla_politica, informa_politica) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(social_trust, social_altruism, firma_peticion, asiste_marcha, part_huelga,
         voto_deber, voto_influye, voto_expresion, interes_politica, habla_politica, informa_politica),
               names_to = "indicator", values_to = "mean_score") %>%
  mutate(
    wave = factor(wave),
    indicator = factor(indicator,
                       levels = c("social_trust","social_altruism", "firma_peticion", "asiste_marcha", "part_huelga", "voto_deber", "voto_influye", "voto_expresion", "interes_politica", "habla_politica", "informa_politica"),
                       labels = c("Social Trust","Social Altruism", "Firmar petición", "Asistir a marcha",
                                  "Participa en huelga", "Votar es un deber", "Mi voto influye", "Mi voto expresa mi opinión", "Interés en política", "Habla de política", "Se informa de política"))
  )

# Asignar subdimensiones según el indicador
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(subdim = case_when(
    indicator %in% c("Social Trust", "Social Altruism") ~ "Interpersonal Trust",
    indicator %in% c("Firmar petición", "Asistir a marcha", "Participa en huelga", 
                     "Votar es un deber", "Mi voto influye", "Mi voto expresa mi opinión",
                     "Interés en política", "Habla de política", "Se informa de política") ~ "Participación política",
    TRUE ~ "Otra"  # Por si acaso hay indicadores no clasificados
  ))

df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(dim = case_when(
    subdim %in% c("Interpersonal Trust") ~ "Redes sociales",
    subdim %in% c("Participación política", "Autoeficacia política", "Interés político") ~ "Participación y actitudes políticas"
  ))

df_long <- df_long %>% select(wave,dim,subdim,indicator,genero, mean_score)

# ---- Observers y outputs ----

observe({
  subdim_choices <- unique(df_long$subdim)
  updateSelectInput(session, "subdim_select",
                    choices = subdim_choices,
                    selected = subdim_choices[1])
})

# Actualizar indicadores según la subdimensión seleccionada
observe({
  req(input$subdim_select)
  
  indicators <- df_long %>%
    filter(subdim == input$subdim_select) %>%
    pull(indicator) %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character()
  
  updateSelectInput(session, "indicator_select",
                    choices = indicators,
                    selected = indicators[1])
})

# Datos filtrados reactivos
filtered_data <- reactive({
  req(input$indicator_select)
  
  df_long %>%
    filter(indicator == input$indicator_select)
})

# Generar gráfico
output$trend_plot <- renderPlotly({
  req(filtered_data())
  
  data_plot <- filtered_data()
  
  # Si NO se desagrega por género, calcular promedio general
  if (!input$include_gender) {
    data_plot <- data_plot %>%
      group_by(wave, indicator, subdim) %>%
      summarise(mean_score = mean(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = 'drop') %>%
      mutate(genero = "Total")
  }
  
  # Crear el gráfico
  if (input$include_gender) {
    # Gráfico con género
    fig <- plot_ly(
      data = data_plot,
      x = ~wave,
      y = ~mean_score,
      color = ~genero,
      colors = c("blue", "red"),
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'lines+markers',
      marker = list(size = 10),
      line = list(width = 2)
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = paste0(input$indicator_select, " por género y año"),
        xaxis = list(
          title = "Año",
          tickfont = list(size = 12)
        ),
        yaxis = list(
          title = "Puntuación media (1-5)",
          range = c(1, 5),
          dtick = 0.5,
          tickfont = list(size = 12)
        ),
        legend = list(
          title = list(text = "Género"),
          font = list(size = 12)
        ),
        hovermode = "x unified"
      )
  } else {
    # Gráfico sin género (total)
    fig <- plot_ly(
      data = data_plot,
      x = ~wave,
      y = ~mean_score,
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'lines+markers',
      marker = list(size = 10, color = 'purple'),
      line = list(width = 2, color = 'purple'),
      name = 'Total'
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = paste0(input$indicator_select, " por año"),
        xaxis = list(
          title = "Año",
          tickfont = list(size = 12)
        ),
        yaxis = list(
          title = "Puntuación media (1-5)",
          range = c(1, 5),
          dtick = 0.5,
          tickfont = list(size = 12)
        ),
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hovermode = "x unified"
      )
  }
  
  fig
})
```


```{r}
# Paquetes
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

library(panelr)
# ---- EJEMPLO RÁPIDO (borra esto y usa tu df real) ----
set.seed(1)



# n <- 300
# df <- data.frame(
#   var_t1 = sample(c("low","mid","high"), n, TRUE, c(.4,.4,.2)),
#   var_t2 = sample(c("low","mid","high"), n, TRUE, c(.3,.5,.2))
# )

names(db_categ)

df1<- db_categ %>% select(id=idencuesta,time=ola,coh_horiz)
df1$time<- as.numeric(df1$time)



df1 <- panel_data(df1, id = id, wave = time)

df<- widen_panel(df1)


# ---- CONFIG ----
lvl <- c("Bajo","Alto")
pal <- c(Bajo = "#1f77b4", Alto = "#ff7f0e")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    var_t1 = factor(coh_horiz_1, levels = lvl),
    var_t2 = factor(coh_horiz_7, levels = lvl)
  ) %>% select(var_t1,var_t2) %>% na.omit()

# ---- CONTAR TRANSICIONES ----
flows <- df %>%
  count(var_t1, var_t2, name = "value")

# ---- NODOS ----
labels <- c(paste0(lvl, " (2016)"), paste0(lvl, " (2023)"))
idx <- setNames(seq_along(labels) - 1, labels)  # 0-index para plotly

# Colores de nodos (mismo color para la misma categoría en t1 y t2)
node_colors <- c(pal[lvl], pal[lvl])

# ---- LINKS (source/target/value/color) ----
links <- flows %>%
  transmute(
    source = idx[paste0(as.character(var_t1), " (2016)")],
    target = idx[paste0(as.character(var_t2), " (2023)")],
    value  = value,
    color  = pal[as.character(var_t1)]  # colorea por estado inicial
  )

# ---- PLOTLY SANKEY ----
plot_ly(
  type = "sankey",
  arrangement = "snap",
  node = list(
    label = labels,
    color = node_colors,
    pad   = 15,
    thickness = 20
  ),
  link = list(
    source = links$source,
    target = links$target,
    value  = links$value,
    color  = links$color
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Movimientos entre 2016 y 2023 (Alto/Bajo) Cohesión Horizontal",
    font = list(size = 12)
  )

```
